mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 4.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (below 1000.0) and retail sales (below 380000.0) signal weak consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High CPI index levels (above 220.0) indicate elevated inflation pressures, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 950.0 units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 950.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is below 11600.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.
